items.headline: Army delays Iowa ammunition detonation to Wednesday
items.summary: The Army has postponed its planned lead azide detonation at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant until Wednesday, citing weather conditions and safety preparations.

items.headline: Turek calls for investigation as environmental groups, state prepare for Army detonation

items.headline: Noon Sunday deadline set in Iowa Army blast challenge; Fort Madison says detonation could come Monday or Tuesday
items.summary: Fort Madison says the Iowa Army detonation could happen Monday or Tuesday. An appeals court ordered a response to the stay request by noon Sunday.
